3dfbxplus engine pass validation
=================================

Tooling strict build:
  cmake -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS='-Wall -Wextra -Werror -pedantic' ..
  cmake --build .
  result: OK

No-stdio importer build:
  cmake -DDFBX_BUILD_TOOLS=OFF -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS='-Wall -Wextra -Werror -pedantic -DFBX_NO_STDIO=1' ..
  result: OK

No-zlib build:
  cmake -DDFBX_BUILD_TOOLS=OFF -DDFBX_ENABLE_ZLIB=OFF -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS='-Wall -Wextra -Werror -pedantic' ..
  result: OK

No-stdio + no-zlib build:
  cmake -DDFBX_BUILD_TOOLS=OFF -DDFBX_ENABLE_ZLIB=OFF -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS='-Wall -Wextra -Werror -pedantic -DFBX_NO_STDIO=1' ..
  result: OK

Source scans:
  direct malloc/calloc/realloc/free calls in 3dfbx/examples: 0
  float/double tokens in 3dfbx/examples: 0
  float-suffix literals in 3dfbx/examples: 0
  direct math.h / sin/cos/sqrt/fabs/tan calls in 3dfbx/examples: 0
  stdio includes in runtime files fbx_fixed/fbx_gackt_runtime: 0

Regression:
  test_quad.fbx fbx_dump output versus pre-refactor baseline: identical
  generated ASCII fixtures: 18 files
  generated ASCII version headers: 6000,6100,7000,7100,7200,7300,7400,7500,7600,7700
  result: regression OK

GACKT export:
  input: test_quad.fbx
  output: test_quad_final_package.gackt
  result: GACKT meshes=1 vertices=6 indices=6 bytes=516
  input: tests/generated/simple_7400_ascii.fbx
  result: GACKT meshes=1 vertices=12 indices=12 bytes=1068

Memory-open smoke:
  fbx_open_memory + raw tree + scene build on test_quad.fbx: version=7400 meshes=1

Material/texture smoke:
  tests/generated/simple_7400_ascii.fbx
  result: materials=1 textures=1 mesh_material_slots=1 submeshes=1

Camera/light smoke:
  tests/generated/camera_light_7400_ascii.fbx
  result: cameras=1 valid_cameras=1 lights=1 valid_lights=1

Fuzz smoke:
  generated corpus mutation cases: 128
  result: fuzz smoke OK; no crash or timeout observed

Important limitation:
  The version fixtures are synthetic ASCII probes with different FBXVersion headers, not a complete Autodesk/Maya/Blender/Mixamo corpus. They prove the refactor did not break the importer smoke path, not that every FBX dialect is fully supported.
